about: I am a Computer Engineering student at Islamic Azad University, Lahijan, with a strong interest in software development.

My current work revolves around web development, especially React and Next.js on the frontend and Go and Node.js on the backend. I enjoy turning ideas into working software and learning by actually building things.

At the same time, I am intentionally spending time on the fundamentals of Computer Science. Discrete Mathematics, algorithms, data structures, operating systems, computer architecture, and other core subjects are an important part of the direction I want to take.
